lines: Then about a week later—.
Roberta's stay at the Fuuma mansion passed noisily yet peacefully.
In battle she shows a bone‑chilling, murderous machine vibe,
but when she's usually serving as a maid she is a modest, gentle woman through and through…
Fuuma Tokiko
Alright, Roberta, this is the point! Remember it well♪
Tokiko
If you add the broth at this moment, the flavor improves.
Roberta
I see. So this is Japanese miso soup… Thank you, Tokiko‑sama.
Roberta
I'm not very good at cooking, so this is a great lesson.
Tokiko
Hehe. No, no. I can do this any number of times♪ Then let's try making a simmered dish next.
So I stood in the kitchen with Tokiko, learning the taste of Japanese home cooking.
And then—.
Izumo Tsuru
Roberta, I acknowledge that your housekeeping skills are impressive. But that is non‑negotiable!
Roberta
Tsuru‑sama? Is something the matter?
Tsuru
Laundry! Leave the washing of clothes to me.
Tsuru
Because panting in freshly‑removed clothes is the ultimate pleasure… No, never mind that.
Tsuru
Washing garments is Izumo Tsuru's duty—as a maid of the Fuuma mansion, I can't give that up.
Roberta
Hmm… Still, I can't accept that.
Tsuru
!? What…!?
Roberta
Just as you take pride in being a maid of this house, I have my own pride as a maid.
Roberta
I can't do a half‑hearted job. Whether it's the master or anyone else, I'll wash every piece of clothing.
Roberta
If you try to stop me, you'll have to force it.
Tsuru
Th-this woman…!? She says she's not interested, yet she's still a thieving cat…?
Igawa Sakura
Hey hey, Fuuma‑kun. Can we just leave that alone?
Me
Y-yeah… It's a hassle, but I'll go stop Tsuru for now…
Then, the maid‑like Tsuru, burning with a strange rivalry, tangled with me.
Even in the middle of those household chores—.
Roberta
Then— I'll attack without reservation. Haaah!!
Taimanin Library
!! What the!!
Giiiin!!!
Library
...Hmm. I'm impressed, Lady Roberta. Truly wonderful skill.
Library
Such strength without using ninjutsu. You must have trained intensely.
Roberta
No, Library‑sama, your fearsome technique lives up to the rumors... One more move, shall we?
Library
Of course. Then I'll go first this time! Haaah!!
Roberta
Giiiin!!!!
Me
Ooooh...??
Me
(Th-this is bad... both are too masterful, I can't even tell what's happening...)
So I trained alongside Library, the head‑gardener of the Fuuma clan, sparring with her.
A week passed while I interacted with the Fuuma family and the people of Gosha.
At last, Roberta's stay in Japan was down to one day left.
Me
Ah, Roberta‑san, you're not in a maid outfit today.
When I went from my room to the living room, Roberta‑san was there in a casual outfit, different from usual.
Roberta
Yes, Master... calling me that in this get‑up is a bit odd.
Roberta
She said to spend the final day as a guest—Tokiko‑san told me so.
Roberta
I decided to indulge in those words, Fuuma‑kun.
Me
Is that so?
I smiled and agreed.
Roberta‑san laid out several weapons—guns, knives—on the table and was cleaning them.
In an ordinary home, this would cause a huge uproar.
But this is Gosha Town, the village of Taimanin.
Weapons and firearms are commonplace here; no one is surprised by this.
Me
It looks like Tokiko and the others aren't around—are you shopping?
Come to think of it, this morning we talked about having a hot‑pot party tonight since it’s Roberta’s last day staying here.
She probably went out to do the shopping.
Roberta
Well, a little while ago. I even offered to carry the luggage.
Roberta
But Tokiko told me to let the guests take it easy, so…
Roberta
And so I’m just relaxing like this.
Roberta smiled, holding a gun part she was disassembling for cleaning.
Me
Haha. I see, Tokiko was right after all.
Me
You’ve worked as a maid for a week now, thanks for your hard work, Roberta.
In the first place Roberta was a guest, and making her do maid work was a strange idea.
Roberta
Oh, don’t worry about that. The maid work was something I asked you to do.
Roberta
Actually I was more worried that I might have been in the way of Tokiko and the others.
Me
Is that so? But I think you were more of a huge help than a nuisance.
I nodded at her, smiling helplessly.
Me
Tokiko and Sakura were really happy to spend time with you.
Me
Well, Tsuru was a bit out of control, but that’s just how she is.
Me
Anyway, even Tsuru seemed to enjoy competing with you.
Roberta
Hehe, is that so?
Me
Yes… but from the side that gets tangled up, it’s pretty rough.
Me
No, I’m really sorry.
When I apologized in place of the violent exclusive maid, Roberta laughed merrily.
Roberta
It’s fine. I enjoyed the back‑and‑forth with Tsuru too—
Roberta
This past week was fun for me too. Everyone in this mansion loves you.
Roberta
It’s like a big family, trusting each other… truly enviable.
Me
Enviable…?
Roberta’s expression clouded slightly with loneliness.
I was curious, so I asked.
Me
But if you call it family, you also have you, Roberta, right? Garcia.
Garcia-kun is the current head of the South American wealthy Labres family—Roberta's rightful master.
He was an earnest boy with no double‑talk, and seemed to be deeply in sync with Roberta.
Roberta
Yes, that's right. Lord Garcia, and the former master—
Roberta
You two taught a blood‑mad hunting hound like me how to live as a human. You turned me back into a human.
Roberta
But I pointed a gun at that Garcia—young master.
Me
That is…
I haven't heard all the details, but apparently such an incident happened before.
She had decided to throw everything away for revenge, and Garcia boy stopped her by risking his own life.
Roberta
I… now live a peaceful life, but sometimes I can't believe that version of myself.
Roberta
Someone like me, stained with blood and sin, being called “family” by that person…
Me
…I think you can believe it. You two are family.
Roberta
Huh?
Roberta looked up and stared at me.
Me
I could see from the outside that you and Garcia truly trusted each other.
Me
So no matter what happened in the past, just believe in that now.
Me
Well, our situation might be different, but—
Me
Even the people in the Fuuma mansion have their own pasts.
Roberta
Fuuma Danjo's rebellion, the kidnapping and confinement by serial killer Saito Hanjiro, etc.
To varying degrees, the residents of the Fuuma mansion have overcome blood‑stained pasts.
Me
Even we manage to get along like a family now.
Me
So Roberta— I’m sorry if that sounds pretentious.
As I scratched my head, she gave a soft smile.
Roberta
No, that's exactly right… If I even gave up trying to believe, I wouldn't be able to face that person.
Roberta
…Thank you, Fuuma. Somehow you encouraged me.
Me
No, that's not—
I gave a wry smile and shook my head.
Seeing Roberta's slightly brighter smile,
I felt, once again, that I had somehow connected with her.
Then, as if changing her mood, Roberta laughed brightly.
Roberta
More importantly— Fuuma, you said last night you wanted to know about assembling a gun, right?
Roberta
I'll show you a demonstration now, so you can learn it if you want.
Me
Whoa! Really, Roberta, thank you!
I leaned forward dramatically toward her gentle smile.
